title: Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: Gregory Bruich received his Ph.D. from the Department of Economics at Harvard University. His research is in public economics. He was selected for the Anya Bernstein Bassett Award for Excellence in Teaching in 2024. He was voted a “Favorite Professor” by the Harvard College Classes of 2022 and 2023.
